rules.name: shows the overlay when a drag carrying files enters the window
rules.source: WindowDropzone.svelte (enter, leave, hover, drop) and window-drag.ts
rules.note: The overlay is not in any fixture: a server render never shows it, so its markup is not machine-checked. From the source: div.window-dropzone[popover=manual][aria-hidden=true] > div.window-dropzone-panel > (span.window-dropzone-icon-frame > upload icon with class window-dropzone-icon) + span.window-dropzone-title holding the children. A drag counts as carrying files when dataTransfer.types holds "Files". Nothing shows while disabled.

rules.name: keeps the overlay while the drag moves between elements inside the window
rules.source: WindowDropzone.svelte (enter, leave, hover, drop) and window-drag.ts
rules.note: Every dragenter with files adds one to a depth and every dragleave takes one away; moving onto a child element fires dragenter on it before dragleave on the one it left.

rules.name: hides the overlay when the drag leaves the window
rules.source: WindowDropzone.svelte (enter, leave, hover, drop) and window-drag.ts
rules.note: The overlay hides when the depth falls back to zero.

rules.name: accepts a file drag over the window as a copy
rules.source: WindowDropzone.svelte (enter, leave, hover, drop) and window-drag.ts
rules.note: dropEffect is "none" while disabled. A dragover that an inner handler already prevented, or that carries no files, is left alone.

rules.name: hides the overlay and reports the dropped files

emits.with: a file selection of the dropped files, any type accepted

rules.source: WindowDropzone.svelte (enter, leave, hover, drop) and window-drag.ts, drop-reading.ts, file-selection.ts (ANY_FILE_POLICY)
rules.note: A drop already prevented by an inner dropzone, a drop without files, a drop while disabled, and a drop that yields no files report nothing.
